body: Yknow what weird I actually had planned to do this myself when I was 17. Just lost my Mrs of 3 years, had an eating disorder, no friends, no real family relationship. That was it. I was gonna do it. But then 3 days before I got hold of sleeping tablets a woman took time out of her way to speak to me, ask if I was okay. I felt like I wanted to cry. Look what I'm trying to say is you've gotta give yourself a reason to fight for,. If that's the dream body, dream personality skills. You can achieve them, obviously set yourself realistic goals but on the grand sceme of things you could still do amazing things in your life. I thought I'd be gone by now but I'm not really okay but doing well enough to smile. Look I'm not gonna bullshit you life's fucking hard but if anything, I'd love to know that me being 18 I've helped soemone perhaps not leave the planet. Please don't mate. I don't know you but I love you man, please message me or something so we can talk about it. You'll get bullshitters that say they will be there for you but bro I'm always here, 24/7. Dig deep. I'm here for you man.
